answer_1.quote: We propose DEGREE (Data-Efficient GeneRation-Based Event Extraction), a generation-based model that takes a passage and a manually designed prompt as the input, and learns to summarize the passage into a natural sentence following a predefined template...
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences following predefined templates that represent event structures

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics. We consider the same criteria in prior works. (1) Trigger F1-score: an trigger is correctly identified (Tri-I) if its offset matches the gold one; it is correctly classified (Tri-C) if its event type also matches the gold one. (2) Argument F1-score: an argument is correctly identified (Arg-I) if its offset and event type match the gold ones; it is correctly classified (Arg-C) if its role matches as well.
